summary: Nasus Pharma Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing an At-The-Market Sales Agreement with BTIG, LLC dated September 18, 2026, permitting sales of ordinary shares under its existing Form F-3 shelf. This is a routine shelf takedown mechanism, not a special situation. The company may sell shares from time to time via BTIG as agent, paying up to 3.0% commission. No price, share count, or premium is specified. Proceeds are intended for clinical development of NS002 and general corporate purposes. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The arrangement creates potential equity overhang; sales are at the company's discretion, subject to market conditions.
